nodes.label: Graph query traversal
nodes.rationale: BFS retrieves broad context; DFS traces chains. Vocabulary-constrained expansion compensates for literal matching without synonyms or translation.

nodes.label: Incremental graph update
nodes.rationale: Changed sources replace prior content, deleted sources are pruned, and only successful semantic extractions are stamped in the manifest.

nodes.rationale: Guide describes intended scaffolding rather than verified current implementation. Layout uses root openapi and nswag while pipeline commands use src/openapi and src/nswag; fallback names API.nswag, so exact paths need review.

nodes.label: EventsHub.OpenApi documentation host
nodes.rationale: Separate host discovers EventsHub.Api controllers through MVC application parts and serves live Swagger.

nodes.label: NSwag typed C# client generation
nodes.rationale: EventsHub.nswag reads generated EventsHub.v1.json and emits EventsHubRpcClient.generated.cs using Newtonsoft.Json; ApiException generation must be enabled.

nodes.label: Graphify knowledge graph pipeline
nodes.rationale: Combines deterministic AST code extraction and cached semantic extraction with community detection, audit report, JSON and interactive HTML.

nodes.label: URL ingestion and folder watching
nodes.rationale: URL ingestion updates the corpus. Watching rebuilds code and flags document changes for semantic updates.

nodes.label: Graph export formats
nodes.rationale: Optional Wiki, Neo4j, FalkorDB, SVG, GraphML and MCP outputs.

nodes.label: Semantic extraction schema
nodes.rationale: Full-path IDs and source provenance prevent duplicate and stale nodes. Explicit, inferred and ambiguous relationships use distinct confidence rubrics.

nodes.label: Cross-repository graph merge
nodes.rationale: Separate CLI extractions keep outputs inside each target folder to avoid overwriting a shared output directory.

nodes.label: Graphify post-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds changed code after commits without a background process; document changes require manual semantic update.

nodes.label: Whisper media transcription
nodes.rationale: Domain hints from graph labels guide transcription; transcripts become semantic input documents.
